verdict.rationale: Notion's integrations directory documents native connections that sync data and connect common tools, including a first-party GitHub sync and several embed-style integrations (Loom, Tableau, Canva, Figma-like design tools). The story's named Slack and Google Drive connections are not evidenced at all. A community complaint about a missing GitHub integration comes from an old thread and is superseded by the current GitHub listing, so it does not create a dispute. missing for 10: evidence of native Slack integration, evidence of native Google Drive integration, depth of the GitHub sync, independent or hands-on corroboration.
